title: OpenAI Reaches $1.25 Trillion Valuation in Funding Round
excerpt: OpenAI has secured a new funding round of $11 billion, bringing its total valuation to $1.25 trillion.
body_html:
Artificial intelligence company OpenAI has reached a valuation of $1.25 trillion following a new funding round that brought in an additional $11 billion. This development places the organization among the most valuable companies globally.

The latest funding follows a previous investment round in March, where the company raised $122 billion from investors at a valuation of $852 billion. Meanwhile, industry rival Anthropic is reportedly nearing its initial public offering.
